title: The direct-image algebra ringed space and its unbounded quasi-coherent derived category
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Put $\mathcal A=f_*\mathcal O_X$, the ring sheaf on $Y$ with $\mathcal A(V)=\mathcal O_X(f^{-1}V)$ and the induced restriction maps. Define the ringed space $Y_{\mathcal A}=(Y,\mathcal A)$ and $g:(X,\mathcal O_X)\to Y_{\mathcal A}$ with underlying map $f$ and identity map $\mathcal A\to f_*\mathcal O_X$ on ring sheaves. Using the category of sheaves of $\mathcal A$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and its derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], define $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal A)$ as the full subcategory of unbounded derived objects $K$ such that every $H^n(K)$, $n\in\mathbb Z$, is quasi-coherent as an $\mathcal A$-module, in the local-presentation sense of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-module-correspondence]. No boundedness condition is imposed.
